from itertools import product


def get_coordinates(coordinate):
    """Return all adjacent coordinates, including diagonals, excluding the coordinate itself."""
    return [
        list(neighbor)
        for neighbor in product(
            *(range(value - 1, value + 2) for value in coordinate)
        )
        if neighbor != coordinate
    ]


assert get_coordinates((3, 4)) == [
    [2, 3], [2, 4], [2, 5],
    [3, 3],         [3, 5],
    [4, 3], [4, 4], [4, 5],
]
